dominant_breach: early lifetime transfer and inheritance timing shaping threshold access and compounding
fastest_washout: missed early threshold moments and delayed compounding

intergenerational_transfer_gate.note: Private transfers determine down payments, debt avoidance, tuition, deposits, business starts, and emergency liquidity before public metrics observe bequests.

inheritance_lifetime_transfer_access.note: Inheritance and lifetime transfers must be separated by timing, amount, race/class, recipient age, liquidity, and threshold moment; aggregate inheritance data understate early family support. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: OECD social-mobility evidence is now bound to inheritance/lifetime-transfer conversion.

early_lifetime_gift_gate.note: Early gifts, guarantees, tuition, rent deposits, and family liquidity are treated as threshold gates because they decide compounding before estate transfer.

bequest_expectation_gap.note: Expected inheritances should not be counted as security until timing, certainty, tax/legal friction, and family division are known.

starter_asset_claim_finality.note: The case requires a starter-asset register for deposits, tuition, emergency funds, cars, co-signing, business capital, and down payments. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: OECD opportunity-gap evidence is now bound to the starter-asset and early-foothold proof burden. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: IRS Trump Accounts material is now bound only as a child-account policy-watch source, not as proof of a broad early-foothold pass. Rev0344 unused-source burn-down: Treasury/IRS Trump Accounts pilot material is now bound only as a pilot/current-law watch source.
